list: The official 55 trophies, 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden. Names and descriptions as PlayStation publishes them (Exophase / PSNProfiles listing, 18 Nov 2026). Guides are written for this entry in its own words; where no published method exists yet, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Follow the roadmap in order: finish the story, clear the stranger strands and the one possibly missable meditation, then work through activities, collectibles and crime in post-story free roam, and finish with 100% completion. Push Square puts the platinum at up to 300 hours; PowerPyx (via EGamers) estimates around 200 hours at difficulty 4 out of 10.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, and it unlocks simply by playing through the start of the story. It cannot be missed: every playthrough begins here, and the trophy pops when the mission ends. Just keep following the on-screen objectives until the mission completes.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: This is the hardest trophy in the list and the last one most players earn. After the story, open Touch Pad, then Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion to see the full checklist — progress made earlier counts, and nothing on it is missable. KeenGamer's roadmap lists what it takes: 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 Cocaine Flamingos, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, 42 drone time trials, the robberies (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), 15 of Bret's hunting objectives, and the rest of the checklist. Work through the checklist itself rather than guessing: it is the only authoritative list of what remains.
steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% Completion checklist (Touch Pad > Progress > Stats > 100% Completion)
Clear every item on that checklist
The trophy pops at 100%

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of the 397 in the game — 100% completion asks for 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the gold. Stunts are jumps and set-piece driving moments scattered across Leonida. Find the ones you have discovered on the map with Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Stunt Spots, and track the count at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Activities, then Stunts. A good habit is to hit every stunt spot you pass during the story, so the post-story cleanup is short.
steps: Open Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see discovered stunts
Complete 250 stunts in total
Keep going to 300 for 100% completion

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types at least once — one round of each is enough, you do not need to win or master any of them. The activities are the map activities: shooting ranges, drone races, races, fishing, arcade games, bowling and the rest that appear as activity markers. Work through them as they unlock during the story and this pops early, and it doubles as a tour of everything the later trophies will ask you to repeat.
steps: Open the map and visit each activity marker type once
Play one round of each of the 9 activity types

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across the game's two shooting ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Find them on the map with Touch Pad, then Activities, then Shooting Ranges, and track progress the same way. Gold medals need accuracy and speed together, so learn each challenge's target pattern first with a slow run, then push for the gold time. This is one of the longest grinds in the list, so start it early and do a few challenges between story missions.
steps: Visit Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range (Port Gellhorn) and Griffin Shooting Range (Balsero)
Gold all 42 challenges
Track progress at Touch Pad > Activities > Shooting Ranges

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — one win per location is enough. Drone races are short, so the skill is learning each course's line rather than raw speed: fly the course once to memorise the gates, then race it for the win. The 100% checklist separately asks for 42 drone time trials across those same 14 locations, so the race wins are only the first pass.
steps: Visit each of the 14 Top Fun locations
Win one drone race at each

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — the same race won twice does not count twice, so you need 20 distinct events. Races are scattered across Leonida as map activities; work through them region by region and tick each new one off. Short circuit races are the fastest wins, so clear those first and leave the long point-to-point races for last.
steps: Win 20 distinct race events
Pick short circuits first, long races last

trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges are head-to-head: you and Cal fish the same spot and the better catch wins. Take the challenge when it appears, and if you lose, try again — there is no report of a one-shot limit. Use the best rod and bait you have, and watch the tension so the line does not snap on a big catch.

Out-fish Cal to win the challenge

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. This is the only trophy in the whole list that PowerPyx, GTABase and GTA Vibes flag as possibly missable, and the risk is one spot: after the mission Down to Earth, look for Lucia at Jason's house in the morning — when she mentions meditating, follow her to the balcony and accept her invitation, and complete that balcony meditation before leaving Chapter 1. It is not confirmed that the balcony spot counts toward the 18, but every guide says to do it before Chapter 1 ends, just in case. The other spots can be done any time, including after the story. Track progress at Touch Pad, then Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations, and see discovered spots on the map at Touch Pad, then Exploration, then Meditate Around Leonida.
steps: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, find Lucia at Jason's house in the morning
Follow her to the balcony and meditate — do this before Chapter 1 ends
Meditate at the remaining spots across Leonida (18 total)

Take Bret's hunting missions when they appear, track the animal, and take it down cleanly. The unique animals are the rare, named targets rather than ordinary wildlife.

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 card sets in the game, and cards are found scattered across Leonida — in shops, in the world, and as rewards. Pick the three sets you are closest to finishing and hunt down their last cards first, rather than collecting at random. For 100% completion you will eventually need 15 full sets, so this trophy is the first third of a much longer collection.

Complete any 3 full card sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK app to WAiNK It at 100 different locations. WAiNK is the in-game scanning app: point it at unfamiliar vehicles, landmarks and locations and it logs them. The habit that makes this painless is to scan everything you pass during the story — every new vehicle and every new place — so the count climbs without a dedicated grind. The 100% checklist also asks for 100 WAiNK locations, so this trophy and that checklist item finish together.
steps: Open the WAiNK app whenever you reach a new place or see an unfamiliar vehicle
WAiNK It at 100 different locations

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the game's 80 challenges. Challenges are the small map objectives scattered across Leonida — short tasks with a clear goal, each one ticking the count up. Pick the easiest ones first and skip anything that looks like a long grind, because you only need 50 of 80. For 100% completion the bar rises to 70 of 80, so the 20 hardest challenges are the only ones you ever get to skip.

Complete any 50 of the 80
Keep going to 70 for 100% completion

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a 4-star wanted level and then lose it and escape. The partner matters: the trophy only counts when you are together, so do a crime with your partner in the car or on foot, wait for the wanted level to hit 4 stars, then break line of sight, hide, and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. Doing it in the countryside, away from dense police patrols, makes the escape much easier.
steps: Be with your partner
Raise your wanted level to 4 stars
Lose the cops and escape the heat

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Plan the route first: pick three shops close together, rob the first, drive straight to the second and then the third, and keep the wanted level alive the whole time — do not stop to lose the cops, and do not let the heat die down. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start again.
steps: Be with your partner and pick 3 shops close together
Rob the first shop
Rob the second and third back-to-back without losing your wanted level

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting in a new vehicle, or scanning it with the WAiNK app, logs it as discovered. The fastest way is variety: drive through different districts, try car parks, dealerships and quiet streets, and scan every unfamiliar vehicle you pass instead of only driving the ones you like. The count is by vehicle type, so the same model twice does not help.
steps: Drive and scan unfamiliar vehicles across Leonida
Discover 100 different vehicles

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-time aiming mode: trigger it when a group of enemies is in front of you, and land five takedowns before it ends. The easiest setup is a mission or a shootout with several enemies grouped together — do not waste it on a lone enemy. If you only get four, try again in the next firefight; there is no limit on attempts.
steps: Wait for a fight with 5 or more enemies grouped together
Trigger Combat Focus
Take down 5 enemies before it ends

Expect a wanted level: the airport is guarded, so go in fast, get airborne quickly, and fly away before the response builds up.

Get into a plane and take off without a scheduled departure

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet: case the store first, move when staff and cameras are looking away, take the goods and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Leave before the alarm is raised

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape, out of the 8 vaults in the game. Vaults open after an optional Chapter 4 mission, and every vault robbery brings a 4-star wanted level, so plan the getaway before you go in: pick your escape vehicle and route first, crack the vault, then run. You need any 5 of the 8, so skip the hardest vaults and do the five you are most comfortable escaping from.

Escape and lose the wanted level

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks this one to a count of 500. The game is full of small choices (dialogue picks, approach choices, what to do in a scene), and they add up across a playthrough. There is nothing special to hunt for: just play the game, make choices whenever they appear, and the count climbs on its own. If it has not popped by the end of the story, keep playing side content and choosing; the choices in stranger missions and activities count too.
steps: Make choices whenever the game offers them
Keep choosing through story and side content until the count reaches 500
